audit.why: FAVOURED 4/10 with Mel on all 7 rows in BOTH layers, matching the packet chart. 49.84% WR is softer than a 7/7 chart implies, but the mechanical case is unusually strong — Lux's entire kit (Q, W, E, R) is projectiles, all reflectable by Rebuttal — so I left the chart alone rather than invent a Lux stage.
Spikes present and correct: level 2 Rebuttal, level 6 execute-through-her-combo, Blackfire/first-item stack spike vs her 60/50/40s Final Spark.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldowns field had no digits; Do's/Don'ts bodies were pasted tradeGood/tradeBad; the force-Prismatic-Barrier-before-you-ult interaction was absent.
audit.why: Light Binding is 10s flat; Final Spark only 60/50/40s; Prismatic Barrier (12-10s) absorbs Mel's R burst window, so the execute must come after the shield is spent. Illumination's auto-reset wind-up is the step-back tell.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns rewritten with real numbers; barrier-before-ult added to loading; bleed bullets replaced with the Q-bait-into-reflect and snare-is-kill-setup lines.

audit.whatIsWrong: 18 misgendered pronoun fields — Lux is she/her. Packet suspectNames (Searing Brilliance, Golden Eclipse) are false positives: both are Mel's own abilities, correctly named.
audit.why: champ-gender authority; ownerKit confirms the names.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed; no edits for the false-positive names.
